standouts.head: Heavy buying on the rise
standouts.text: Volume on the current rise runs 66% above its 50-day average.
standouts.learn: A rise on heavy volume has buyers behind it; a thin rise often fades.

standouts.head: MACD positive
standouts.text: MACD is above its signal line and above zero, with the histogram falling.
standouts.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; a cross up through its signal says momentum is turning.

against.head: A bearish engulfing day
against.text: On Oct 30 it opened over the prior close and closed under the prior open: sellers took the day back in full.
against.learn: A session whose body swallows the one before: one side has taken over.

against.head: Uptrend structure broken, then reclaimed
against.text: On Aug 19 it closed under the Jul 23 higher low, ending the run of higher lows, and it has closed back over that low since.
against.learn: An uptrend steps up in higher highs and higher lows; a lower high is the first warning, and losing the last higher low breaks it.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing
material.text: Price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: Retesting its breakout level
material.text: It broke out above the September high and has come back to test it from above: old resistance acting as new support.
material.learn: After a breakout, price often comes back to the line it broke; old resistance becomes new support.

material.head: Downtrend broken: over its last swing high
material.text: The swings had been falling, but price has closed over the last swing high (Oct 2): the run of lower highs is broken.
material.learn: A downtrend's first crack: a close over its latest lower high.

material.head: Sitting on support
material.text: Price sits on the buy zone.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.
